supersession_reason: Fresh August/July 2026 prior art materially narrows generic proposal-authority and evidence-gated-verification claims; prior registry remains immutable history.

claims.claim: RAKL is a distinct scientific-method layer only if the conjunction of contextual local-view atlas, typed non-forced gluing, multi-axis scientific authority, evidence-gated canonical updates, residual-driven recursion, semantic/evidence-lineage saturation, immutable negative history and externally governed self-application is not semantically equivalent to pre-cutoff prior art.
claims.falsifier: A pre-cutoff prior method implements a semantically equivalent integrated control law after terminology normalization.

claims.claim: Within RAKL, proposer output alone cannot increase canonical scientific authority.
prior_art_narrowing: Active Epistemic Control, arXiv:2602.03974, separates grounded facts from simulated beliefs for commitment
The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes, arXiv:2608.04066, gives a deterministic executive ownership of belief while the LLM files typed proposals
Evidence-Graded Decision Authorization, medRxiv 2026.05.19.26353565, licenses claim/action types according to evidence level
EG-VAR, arXiv:2607.12650, makes a formal kernel the sole minter of Verified claims
claims.falsifier: An admissible RAKL transition exists in which proposer text raises canonical authority without new evidence or a licensed authority rule.

claims.claim: Weaker, mixed or differently scoped relation edges do not imply stronger equivalence without a licensed composition map.
claims.falsifier: A valid RAKL closure promotes mixed/weak relation paths to stronger authority without additional evidence/assumptions.

claims.claim: Aligned incompatible views may remain a plural atlas, obstruction or identified set rather than being forced into one global theory.
claims.falsifier: RAKL requires arbitrary global selection despite unresolved incompatibility or non-identifiability.

claims.claim: Null, refuted and withdrawn-authority events remain addressable after later updates.
claims.falsifier: A valid successor state can erase a prior negative/withdrawal event without explicit supersession provenance.

claims.claim: RAKL stopping combines retained semantic novelty, route coverage, process independence, evidence-lineage independence and residual-driven reopening.
claims.falsifier: RAKL certifies a fiber with missing required routes, unresolved lineage overlap, new retained semantic objects or an in-scope native residual.

claims.claim: Matched RAKL controls reduce epistemic failure modes beyond final-output improvements.
claims.falsifier: Under matched model/tool/budget/evaluator conditions, relevant controls do not improve their registered process metrics or only improve presentation/outcome quality.

claims.claim: Self-RAKL can improve method modules without granting candidates authority over the evidence/evaluator that judges the same improvement.
claims.falsifier: A candidate-controlled evaluator, benchmark mutation or untrusted execution subject can independently authorize active promotion.

claims.claim: RAKL represents scientific authority as a scoped partial/product order across grounding, representation/relation, mechanism, identification and decision coordinates, preventing strength in one coordinate from silently upgrading another.
claims.falsifier: Pre-cutoff scientific-agent or scientific-method work is found with semantically equivalent multi-axis claim authority, incomparability and axis-specific no-escalation semantics; or matched ablations show no reduction in cross-layer authority leakage.

new_closest_neighbors.title: The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes
new_closest_neighbors.effect: Generic LLM-proposal/deterministic-commit separation is strong current prior art and must not be claimed as uniquely RAKL.

new_closest_neighbors.title: Evidence-Graded Decision Authorization for Safe Clinical AI
new_closest_neighbors.effect: Evidence-graded claim/action authorization is prior art; RAKL must distinguish multi-axis scientific authority from one evidence-level gate.

new_closest_neighbors.title: Evidence-Grounded Verified Agentic Reasoning
new_closest_neighbors.effect: A kernel-owned Verified status with attested evidence and abstention is prior art for strict verified-claim minting.

new_closest_neighbors.title: GAVEL
new_closest_neighbors.effect: Atomic evidence contracts and mechanized citation validation are prior art relevant to RAKL claim-evidence provenance.

claim_update_rule: This registry may be narrowed, refuted or superseded with history preserved. It may not silently broaden novelty or weaken a falsifier after observing results or reviewer feedback.
